title: Tiny, cute palm tree
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='sun' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFF9C4'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#FFD54F'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id='trunkGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='0'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#8D6E63'/>
      <stop offset='50%' stop-color='#A1887F'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#6D4C41'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='sandGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFE082'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#FFD54F'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Sand mound -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='88' rx='38' ry='9' fill='#F9A825'/>

  <path d='M47.5 46 Q50 44 52.5 46' stroke='#5D4037' stroke-width='1' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- Trunk highlight -->
  <path d='M47 82 Q46 70 47.5 55 Q49 42 50 34' stroke='#BCAAA4' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- Coconuts -->

  <!-- Left drooping -->

  <path d='M24 35 L21 40' stroke='#43A047' stroke-width='1' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- Left small frond -->

  <!-- Right small frond -->
  <path d='M53 33 Q62 24 72 25 Q64 28 53 33 Z' fill='#81C784'/>

  <!-- Small flowers on sand -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='87' r='1.5' fill='#F48FB1'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='88' r='1.5' fill='#F48FB1'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='90' r='1.2' fill='#CE93D8'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='90' r='1.2' fill='#CE93D8'/>
